verdict.rationale: The MCP-client axis applies because RudderStack ships its own AI agent (Rudder AI in Slack), and that agent could plausibly consume external MCP servers. The evidence only shows RudderStack as an MCP server for clients like Claude, Cursor and Codex. That is the opposite role and earns no credit here. Nothing in the pack shows users plugging third-party MCP servers into RudderStack or its agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
